previous_sql: SELECT card_scheme, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM fact_payment_attempt WHERE auth_status = 'success' GROUP BY card_scheme ORDER BY payment_count DESC
question: dame el número de pagos válidos por tipo de financiación de la tarjeta, ordenado de más a menos
sql: SELECT d.card_scheme, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM fact_payment_attempt f JOIN dim_card d ON f.card_sk = d.card_sk WHERE f.auth_status = 'success' GROUP BY d.card_scheme ORDER BY payment_count DESC
